messages:
alex: Quick check — can we lock the stop criteria and audience-overlap guardrails for the reranker-v3 A/B? Planning to start the canary tomorrow morning (UTC).

priya: Yes. Proposed stop rules: 1) p-value > 0.1 for primary CTR lift after 24h, 2) negative impact on latency > 50ms for 5m rolling, 3) error rate > 0.5% sustained for 10m. If any trigger, immediately rollback. :warning:

jamie: +1 on those. Also add a minimum sample size rule: at least 10k impressions per variant before making decisions. Otherwise metrics are noisy.

sophie: Who's owning the monitoring runbook during the canary? I can do the first 4 hours if someone else covers the next shift.

alex: @sophie thanks — can you own 06:00-10:00 UTC? @jamie can you cover 10:00-18:00 UTC? I'll be on-call for rollback actions.

jamie: yep, I'll cover 10-18 UTC and prepare the alert dashboard.

priya: For overlap checks, use this query to ensure the experiment audiences are disjoint from other active flags: 

```
-- check user overlap between current experiment cohort and any active flags
SELECT f.flag_name, COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id) AS overlap_count
FROM feature_flag_assignments f
JOIN experiment_cohort e ON f.user_id = e.user_id
WHERE e.experiment = 'reranker_v3_ab'
  AND f.flag_active = TRUE
GROUP BY f.flag_name
ORDER BY overlap_count DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

priya: If overlap_count > 100 for any single flag, we should evaluate cross-flag interactions.

alex: Nice. Also want a quick config snippet for the rollout so ops can apply it to the feature flag system: 

```
{
  "flag": "reranker_v3_ab",
  "variants": ["control", "reranker_v3"],
  "split": [50, 50],
  "min_sample": 10000,
  "stop_rules": {
    "pvalue_threshold": 0.1,
    "latency_ms_threshold": 50,
    "error_rate_pct": 0.5
  },
  "monitoring_channels": ["#eng-oncall", "#eng-platform"],
  "owner": "sophie"
}
```

sophie: Looks good. Can we reduce initial traffic to 10/10/80 for a short warmup? i.e., 10% control, 10% treatment, 80% reserved for ramp. Plan: after 30m if no triggers, switch to 50/50.

alex: I like the warmup. Change split workflow: start 10/10, wait 30m, then 50/50. Add a canary tag so we don't confuse metrics pipelines.

jamie: I'll add the canary_tag = "reranker_v3_canary_2026-03-18" to the events so experiments pipeline can filter. Also will add an automated check that compares daily entropy between cohorts to detect skew.

priya: For stopping rules automation, I suggest the rule engine evaluate at 5m frequency and require confirmation over two consecutive windows before auto-rollback — prevents flapping during short spikes.

alex: Sounds reasonable. So: rule engine @5m, need 2 consecutive violated windows OR single catastrophic violation (error rate > 2% or latency > 200ms) to auto-rollback. Everything else triggers a pager and human review.

deploy-bot: deploy queued for feature-flag update reranker_v3_ab (owner: sophie). Estimated rollout window: 06:00 UTC -> initial 10% traffic.

sophie: I'll update the runbook with escalation steps, links to dashboard panels, and the rollback command. Quick ping: who can review the PR for the flag change?

jamie: PR review in 30m. I'll take it.

alex: Thanks team — final checklist for tomorrow: 1) PR merged + deploy, 2) runbook published, 3) monitoring dashboard wired, 4) overlap query run and any high overlaps investigated. If all green, start warmup at 06:00 UTC.

priya: Added a quick note in the experiment doc about A/B metric definitions and secondary metrics to watch (CTR, session_length, latency_p95).

sophie: Perfect. I'll post an update in #general once the canary begins. :rocket:
